global_issues.title: Lutnick confirms targeted chip tariffs on non-US builders
global_issues.note: Confirmed by Korea Times, Seoul Economic Daily, and Bloomberg reporting from 2026-09-03. Lutnick described a 'targeted, thoughtful' tariff policy with explicit build-in-US-or-pay language directed at Samsung/SK hynix; administration is also weighing expanding tariffs to finished products (servers, laptops). Still current as of 2026-09-04.

global_issues.title: Fed's Waller ties next rate move to inflation data
global_issues.note: Confirmed by Bloomberg/CNBC/Benzinga 2026-09-03: Waller said Sept rate decision hinges on August CPI, leans toward holding steady absent a hot inflation surprise, called for 'giving disinflation a chance'. Matches briefing framing.

grok_report.summary: Both cited global issues (chip tariffs, Waller's rate comments) are accurately reported and current. However, the briefing omits a critical same-day event — renewed Iranian strikes on Jordan, Kuwait, UAE and Bahrain with Brent crude spiking above $95/bbl — which multiple outlets flagged as a key overhang on the Nasdaq that session. Watchlist price/percentage figures and the PLTR TITAN contract narrative check out against reporting; no factual stock errors found, but the mood/summary section understates geopolitical risk beyond tariffs.
